title: LinkLayer reads rekeyed peer registry outside security lock
description: Security review: _find_sender snapshots _rekeyed_peers.values() without the security lock while rotation mutates the dict from another thread. Concurrent receive/rekey can raise iteration errors or observe incoherent candidates. Snapshot candidate identities under _security_lock without awaiting, retain final retired-key check, and add threaded receive/rotation stress for linearizable outcomes.
